text:
Michael Amadio has eight goals in 25 games for Ottawa, including an unassisted one and the opener against Calgary, and he ranks 47th in the league in wins added by goals. For a third-round pick on his fourth team, that's a big season so far.

The finishing comes with a warning. Eight goals on 5.5 expected means 23% shooting, after 16% last season, and that rarely lasts. His point rate (2.04 per 60) is above his talent range. But there's real substance underneath: Evolving-Hockey had him 73rd among forwards in wins above replacement last season, and the Senators take 55% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on. All Three Zones tracking (Corey Sznajder's) says his offense lives in transition, 57% of his shots off the rush. He has no power-play points, so all of it comes at even strength. He won the Cup with Vegas in 2023. Our range projects 36 to 54 points and 15 to 25 goals.
